summary: The cabinet preserves the main design and taller body, but its pale colors, weak wood texture, small knobs and feet, and camera angle differ from the approved image.
revisionInstructions: Edit the existing scene materials to match the approved image's deeper teal paint and saturated orange knobs and feet. For assetId 4e879ca5-cf5f-4995-8781-005ebaf51858, role: round orange knob shapes and color; inspect only, use the approved image to resolve the contact sheet's paler orange appearance.
Add subtle painted wood grain and restrained surface variation to the body, doors, knobs and feet, preserving the clean stylized finish.

For assetId 4e879ca5-cf5f-4995-8781-005ebaf51858, role: round orange knob shapes and color; inspect only, enlarge the existing round knob heads modestly while preserving their placement near the central seam.

For assetId f61fead0-57fb-457f-805e-4dc5398de282, role: orange foot shape and placement; inspect only, increase the existing feet's visible height and thickness to better match the approved image, retaining their tapered shape and corner placement.

Lower the input camera elevation slightly and reduce the sideward angle to match the approved front-right view's smaller top and right-side exposure. Update the saved direction properties and the input entry in gen3d_reference_camera_framing, adjusting center and orthoScale to preserve comparable framing.

modelReferences.role: overall body proportions and standalone starting mesh; adapt to a slightly taller cabinet
modelReferences.intendedTraits: Rectangular cabinet, shallow overhanging top, narrow front stiles and bottom rail, and solid side panel.
modelReferences.deliberateDifferences: The cabinet body should be eight percent taller than the reusable source while retaining its design.

observations.detail: The visible top overhang, front frame and solid right side preserve the source structure.
The front panels appear taller relative to their width than the source's front view; the exact eight percent change cannot be verified visually.
The output does not reveal the back or underside for comparison.

modelReferences.intendedTraits: Two flat rectangular doors of equal width, separated by a narrow central seam and fitted within the front frame.
modelReferences.deliberateDifferences: Door height follows the authorized taller cabinet body.

observations.detail: Both doors are rectangular, aligned at their upper and lower edges, and meet at a narrow vertical seam.
The closed frontal view does not expose enough door edge to assess thickness reliably.

modelReferences.role: round orange knob shapes and color; inspect only
modelReferences.intendedTraits: Two rounded orange knob heads with shallow projecting profiles.
modelReferences.deliberateDifferences: The approved image requires stronger orange saturation than the pale contact-sheet appearance.

observations.detail: Both visible heads have round outlines and rounded surfaces.
The heads appear smaller relative to the doors than in the approved image.
The output knobs are peach-colored rather than the approved saturated orange.
The stems are largely occluded by the heads.

modelReferences.role: orange foot shape and placement; inspect only
modelReferences.intendedTraits: Four short tapered orange block feet positioned beneath the cabinet corners.
modelReferences.deliberateDifferences: The approved image governs orange saturation and apparent foot mass; sheet lighting is supplementary.

observations.detail: The output shows tapered block feet beneath the front and rear corner regions.
The exposed feet look shorter and lighter in mass relative to the cabinet than the approved image.
The cabinet partially occludes the rear feet, limiting comparison of their full shapes.
The cabinet has the correct overall outline, but the view exposes proportionally more top and right side than the approved image, indicating a slightly higher and more sideward camera.
The taller body is consistent with the requested adaptation, but the knob heads and exposed feet appear undersized relative to it.
The paired doors sit within the front frame, the knobs flank the center seam near mid-height, and the feet occupy the corner regions.
The two doors, two round knobs, overhanging top, front stiles, bottom rail and tapered feet are present. No concrete extra structural feature is visible.
The body is pale cyan rather than deep teal, the orange parts are washed out, and the surfaces lack the approved image's visible painted wood grain.
